verdict.rationale: monday.com documents its own generic integration capability: 2-way sync with "any platform" and a "real-time, cross-platform view". That plausibly lets external work items appear in monday. However, no evidence names another project-management tool such as Jira, Asana or Trello, or shows a unified per-user view of assigned tasks; GitHub/GitLab PR linking covers code, not PM tasks. missing for 10: named integrations with other PM tools, a documented aggregated "my assigned tasks" view across sources, details on how assignment syncs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see my assigned tasks from multiple project management tools in one unified view

citations.quote: Enable 2-way sync between monday products and any platform you work with to trigger automations, eliminate manual work, and keep your business in motion.
Gain a real-time, cross-platform view that keeps data aligned and teams empowered
Discover 850+ integrations and apps to centralize work
